dish.title: Sicilian Pasta alla Norma with Golden Eggplant and Ricotta Salata
dish.description: Rigatoni tossed in a garlicky tomato-basil sauce with cubes of eggplant shallow-fried in olive oil until golden outside and creamy inside, finished with grated ricotta salata and torn basil.

recipe_version.title: Sicilian Pasta alla Norma with Golden Eggplant and Ricotta Salata
recipe_version.description: Rigatoni tossed in a garlicky tomato-basil sauce with cubes of eggplant shallow-fried in olive oil until golden outside and creamy inside, finished with grated ricotta salata and torn basil.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: 1/2 cup for the eggplant, 2 tbsp for the sauce, plus a little for the pan if needed

ingredients.name: ricotta salata
ingredients.display_name: ricotta salata made with microbial or vegetable rennet

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp pasta pot, 1/2 tbsp (1 1/2 tsp) eggplant and sauce

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Cut the eggplants into 3/4-inch cubes. Thinly slice the garlic, crush the tomatoes by hand in a bowl, pick the basil leaves, and coarsely grate the ricotta salata.

steps.title: Heat the pasta pot
steps.body: Fill an 8-quart pot with 16 cups water and 2 tbsp salt, cover, and set it over high heat. It takes about 16 minutes to come to a boil, which runs inside steps 3 and 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Shallow-fry the eggplant
steps.body: Heat 1/4 cup olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Add half the eggplant in one layer and cook, turning with a slotted spoon, until golden on most sides and creamy inside, about 6 minutes per batch. Drain on a towel-lined plate and sprinkle with 1/2 tsp salt. Repeat with another 1/4 cup oil and the rest of the eggplant (2 batches).

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium and add 2 tbsp oil. Cook the garlic and crushed red pepper until the garlic is pale gold, about 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and 1/2 tsp salt and simmer, stirring now and then, until thickened, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the rigatoni
steps.body: Once the pot boils (early in step 4), add the rigatoni and cook until al dente, about 11 minutes. Scoop out 1/2 cup of the cooking liquid, then drain. This runs inside step 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Add the rigatoni and two-thirds of the eggplant to the sauce with half the basil, torn, and toss 1 minute, adding splashes of the reserved cooking liquid until glossy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Divide among bowls, top with the remaining eggplant and basil, and shower with the ricotta salata.

scaling_notes.1: A quarter of everything: half a small eggplant in one batch in a 10-inch skillet; 4 oz rigatoni in a 4-quart pot with 8 cups water.
scaling_notes.2: Half of everything; fry the eggplant in one batch in the 12-inch skillet; 8 oz pasta in a 6-quart pot with 12 cups water.
do_not_scale: eggplant: one layer per batch; crowding steams it and it soaks up oil
